description: Template. Copy to clinic_config.json and fill with your own retrospective outcomes. `batches` is a list of [successes, transfers] pairs, one per reporting period — these anchor the Beta-Binomial prior in L3 and supply the 95% CI reported by BEFE (L7). Set use_clinic_data=true once populated. The real clinic_config.json is deliberately not published: it contains a clinic's own outcome statistics.

_notes.batches: Aggregate counts only — never per-patient rows. A period with fewer than ~20 transfers contributes little and widens the posterior, which is the intended behaviour.
_notes.minimum_recommended: At least 3 periods and 100 transfers total before the clinic prior meaningfully shifts the posterior away from the literature-derived default.
_notes.privacy: These are counts, not records. Do not add identifiers, dates of birth, or free-text fields to this file.
